description: Pioneer Cement Limited was incorporated in Pakistan as a public company limited by shares on 9 February 1986 and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its principal activity is the manufacturing and sale of cement, produced at a plant located at Chenki, District Khushab, in central Punjab. The company markets Ordinary Portland Cement and Sulphate Resistant Cement.
sourceNote: Written from: https://pioneercement.com/ (products, head office), https://pioneercement.com/about-us/company-profile/ and https://pioneercement.com/about-us/our-management/ (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Ordinary Portland Cement
products.summary: OPC, which the company describes as an ideal building material for almost all structural work including all kinds of concrete construction.

products.name: Sulphate Resistant Cement
products.summary: SRC, for construction where sulphate salts are present in the soil or saline water, particularly foundations and areas subject to sulphate attack.
